Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.description: How we collect and protect your data in Pet & Found.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data Collection and Authentication
dataCollection.content: To ensure the security of the platform and prevent spam, we use Google Firebase Authentication. When you create an account, we store the basic information provided by your login provider (such as email address and public name). We do not have access to passwords if you use social login.

location.title: 2. Location Data
location.content: The platform collects location data (latitude and longitude) exclusively when you report a lost or seen animal, voluntarily, through clicking on the interactive map. We do not track your location in real-time or in the background.

storage.title: 3. Image Storage
storage.content: The photos uploaded for reports are hosted publicly in our cloud infrastructure (Cloudflare R2). By uploading, you agree that these images will be visible publicly on the map to help identify the animal. You can delete the images at any time by deleting or editing your report.

contact.title: 4. Contact
contact.content: Since this is an open-source/portfolio project, data can be removed from the database at any time without prior notice. If you wish to request manual and immediate deletion of your data, please contact the developer.

security.title: Security Warning
security.description: Please read the tips below carefully before posting your alert to the community:
security.tip1: Avoid placing contact information (phone/email) in the description. Use the platform's internal chat.
security.tip2: Never place the exact address of your home in the descriptions or observations.
security.tip3: If you plan to meet someone to pick up or deliver an animal, choose public, busy locations and don't go alone.
